description:
## Context

With `RenderLoop` in place (child 2), `Interactive` no longer calls `render_frame/1` → `Renderer.render` → `Terminal.write` directly. Instead it computes the render state and hands it to the Task.

## Implementation

### Step 1 — Start RenderLoop from Interactive.run/1

In `run/1`, after the terminal and renderer setup, start `RenderLoop` and store the pid in state:

```elixir
{:ok, render_loop} = RenderLoop.start_link(
  width: width,
  height: height,
  terminal: terminal
)
```

Add `render_loop: pid()` to the `Interactive` struct and `@type t`.

### Step 2 — Replace render_frame/1 with send_render/1

Replace:
```elixir
defp render_frame(state) do
  ...
  {:ok, bytes} = Renderer.render(state.renderer, lines, cursor_seq)
  if bytes != "", do: Terminal.write(state.terminal, bytes)
  state
end
```

With:
```elixir
defp send_render(state) do
  input = Components.Input.update_scroll(state.input, state.width)
  state = %{state | input: input}
  input_lines = Components.Input.render(input, state.width)
  {lines, layout} = build_screen(state, input_lines)
  lines = composite_active_overlay(state, lines)
  cursor_seq = cursor_position(state, input_lines, lines, layout)
  send(state.render_loop, {:render, lines, cursor_seq})
  state
end
```

All call sites of `render_frame` become `send_render`.

### Step 3 — Resize

In the `%Resize{}` handler, send `{:resize, w, h}` to the RenderLoop after updating Interactive state:

```elixir
send(state.render_loop, {:resize, w, h})
```

### Step 4 — Shutdown

In `terminate/2`, send `:stop` to the RenderLoop:

```elixir
send(state.render_loop, :stop)
```

### Step 5 — Remove renderer field

`state.renderer` (the old Renderer GenServer pid) is no longer needed in `Interactive`. Remove it from the struct, `@type t`, and `run/1` setup.

## Acceptance criteria

- `render_frame/1` deleted from `Interactive`
- `send_render/1` sends `{:render, lines, cursor_seq}` to the RenderLoop Task
- `state.renderer` field removed; `state.render_loop` added
- Resize sends `{:resize, w, h}` to RenderLoop
- `terminate/2` sends `:stop` to RenderLoop
- All existing Interactive tests pass (tests that call `build_screen/1` directly are unaffected)
- Verified in tmux: thinking spinner clears immediately when agent finishes, confirming the final-frame bug is resolved
title: Wire Interactive to RenderLoop; remove render_frame/1
